name: sales_vs_target
title: Sales versus target by region, January to June 2026
purpose: Monthly net sales by region against the FY2026 v3 target: variance, variance %, cumulative variance and the year-to-date result.
limitations: Worked example of the rule-of-thumb-model plugin: the data are generated by make_data.py (seed 20261125).
Targets are monthly; there is no weekly view.
Amounts are net of VAT, as the source delivers them.

items.label: Display scale (fixed at 1000)
items.note: Fixed: every unit label of an amount in this example is in KRW thousand; the sales and the targets are landed in KRW and divided by this scale. A model in another unit needs the labels changed (task.md).

items.label: Alert when a region-month is below target by more than
Regions

checks.label: Actual block total equals the raw sales total
Target block total equals the raw target total
Variance block total equals actual minus target
Cumulative variance in June equals the variance block total
YTD variance % times target total equals variance total (target not 0)
checks.note: A target total of 0 gives 0 % (IFERROR) and the check then compares 0 with 0.

checks.label: Variance % times target, summed, equals the variance (target not 0)
checks.note: A region-month with a target of 0 shows 0 % (IFERROR) and is left out: its product is 0 and its variance is not counted.

checks.label: All regions by month: variance % times target equals the variance (target not 0)
checks.note: Reads the items var_pct, tgt and var of the block bridge by id, so the check follows them when the items are reordered. A month with a target of 0 shows 0 % (IFERROR) and is left out: its product is 0 and its variance is not counted.

checks.label: Variance % cells that are not numbers
Region-months below target by more than the alert input

notes.text: Amounts are net of VAT, in KRW; the model shows KRW thousand (display scale on inputs).
Targets are the FY2026 v3 plan.
A region-month with a target of 0 shows a variance % of 0 % (IFERROR in the variance % grid); the check pct_grid_ties leaves it out. In this extract every region-month has a target above 0.
Lines without a product code (27 of 600 in this extract) count in the regional totals.
Every raw row is covered by a helper row; after a refresh with more rows, run rotm.py check and, if it reports uncovered rows, rotm.py extend.
